info.name: OpenRegister API: credentials, integrations, object access state, settings
info.description: T22 coverage collection. Covers credentialOauth2, integrations, objectIntegrations, objectSharing, objectOwnership, objectPermissions, objectGrants, objectFavourite, objectReadState, objectShareLink, icon, flowTimerDiagnostic, settings, preferences, migration, tables, Settings\ConfigurationSettings and Settings\LlmSettings routes: success path, unknown id, invalid input and the non-admin access answer. It seeds its own data in `00 setup` (two non-admin users via OCS, a register, an admin-only schema, two objects) and removes it in `99 teardown`; it depends on no other collection. Settings writes put back the values they read.
